brief.t: First: stop the BuffMan filling-line commitment until the equipment scope and landed cost are verified. The supplier quoted $8,850 DDP and Aiden is asking whether both machines support hot fill and batch coding. Confirm the machine configuration, coding method, quote inclusions, and total approved spend before payment or shipment.

Second: turn Ashley / Earth and Ash payment-ready. Ashley asked again last night for the Miron glass invoice so she can pay. Laura committed July 23 to send it; confirm the invoice, glass order status, and white natural-paper-label quote today.

Third: protect open customer production commitments. Natugeda still needs a verified Hair Oil production stage and date; do not let stale “Production Scheduled” language substitute for an operations fact. Separately, PHYLARA has paused after sample satisfaction and requests its final formula/specifications plus confirmation of any balance.

Fourth: deal with the payable and equipment exposure with facts, not email links. The July 29 bitop dunning notice and CH Robinson invoice remain unvalidated; add the $8,850 DDP freight quote to the cash decision only after matching all three items to internal records.

Victor is due tomorrow for packaging compatibility and complete quote inputs. The authoritative July 20 update remains: PLL reached him, and he will confirm Edge Control packaging compatibility; no final quote yet.
Aleta remains a qualified type-4C detangler lead. Get formula brief, units, packaging, launch timing, and budget before pricing.

CRM is still at the sign-in page. Counts, overdue work, pipeline figures, and the Assign To defect are carried forward only; CRM Developer has not supplied a verified resolution to the customer-page task assignment issue.

kb.a: On July 30, Aiden asked whether both proposed BuffMan filling machines support hot fill. Yuhang’s forwarded freight quote is USD 8,850 DDP door-to-door; he asked what batch coding is required and indicated coding can print on bottles or labels. The quotation scope, machine configuration, coding method, and final landed cost need verification before payment, order, or shipment.

Ashley, rebranding Earth & Ash as Nymphaea, confirmed white natural paper labels and asked again July 29 for the Miron glass invoice so she can pay. Laura said a subcontracted label price takes 2–3 days and final approved rolls take about two weeks after payment; the Miron invoice/order status and label quote are not verified as complete.

Natugeda requested Hair Oil production status and a timeline. The last authenticated CRM capture listed it as Production Scheduled, but CRM is unavailable and no current stage or delivery date is verified. Operations must provide facts before any customer update.

PHYLARA’s Shannon says she is happy with the sample but is pausing the project for personal-timeline reasons. She requested the final formula/specifications and confirmation of any remaining balance. Treat this as a controlled pause: confirm release permissions, documents, and ledger status before replying.

bitop AG’s July 29 dunning notice requested payment to avoid further fees. The amount, original invoice, and any material or production hold remain unverified; finance must match it to the ledger before payment.

CH Robinson issued invoice 6247783636 for load 555812351 on July 29. The amount, due date, and shipment/customer linkage were not independently verified. Validate internally before payment or a delivery commitment.

Victor’s task is due July 31. The authoritative day update says PLL reached him; he will confirm packaging compatibility with the Edge Control formula. Full cost inputs and a final quote remain unverified.

The authoritative day update remains that Kenna’s meeting was postponed to Tuesday, July 21 with no time confirmed. The confirmed product direction is cleanser and oil-cleanser support; no current meeting time, quote, or price is verified.

Constance said Aleta’s first hero product is a type-4C detangler intended to provide extra slip for thick and thin hair. Formula requirements, units, packaging, launch timing, and budget remain unqualified; no MOQ or price has been promised.

Chris confirmed Australian sporting balm recipes use heating and cooling effects. U.S. heating, cooling, muscle-recovery claims, or active ingredients may trigger OTC-drug requirements. Do not quote or promise cosmetic manufacture without formula/claims review and regulatory classification.

Live CRM is at a sign-in screen July 30. The last authenticated capture showed 11 tasks, 8 overdue, 9 active deals, $1,327,800 pipeline, 20 projects in production, and $57,454.99 deposits; these are not live-verified. The customer-page Assign To dropdown was still reported broken July 28, and no verified CRM Developer closure was found.
